name: dsh-pai-web
description: DSH plugin for LOCAL web surfing (no remote search API). Provides `pai_web_ops` with actions: search, fetch, search_and_fetch, browse. Search runs in local headless Chromium (Playwright) over a public HTML engine; fetch prefers local web_fetch (http), then Chromium, then plain fetch. DeepSeek-hosted web_search is disabled by overlay.
